source_semantics: user in control of a wallet unit
semantic_note: Do not introduce a universal WalletUser kind into Core; holder/control semantics depend on interaction.

source_semantics: unique configuration of a wallet solution for an individual wallet user, including wallet instance and secure components
semantic_note: More specific than CM4DI Wallet role; likely EUDI mapping/package construct, not new Core concept.

source_semantics: combination of software, hardware, services, settings and configurations required to operate wallet capabilities
semantic_note: Product/system construct; should not be equated with Wallet role or DigitalIdentity.

source_semantics: software component/instance through which user interacts with wallet unit
semantic_note: Operational software instance, not a new identity semantic primitive.

source_semantics: natural/legal person providing wallet solutions
semantic_note: Provider role is EUDI-specific; keep profile/mapping level.

source_semantics: legally governed person identification data issued to wallet units
semantic_note: CM4DI PID is profile concept; exact EU mandatory/optional attribute schema remains EUDI mapping data.

source_semantics: attestation carrying attributes with qualified/public-body/non-qualified legal categories
semantic_note: Specific legal EAA categories are EUDI mappings/specializations rather than Core Credential classes.

source_semantics: provider responsible for issuing/revoking PID and binding it cryptographically to wallet unit
semantic_note: Provider combines credential issuer and governed service-provider responsibilities.

source_semantics: provider issuing EAA classes to wallet units
semantic_note: Qualified/public-body/non-qualified distinctions remain jurisdiction/profile-specific.

source_semantics: attestation enabling relying parties/providers to validate wallet-unit authenticity/status
semantic_note: Do not conflate Wallet Unit Attestation with PID/EAA or Authenticator.

source_semantics: relying party intending to rely on wallet units for public/private digital services
semantic_note: Clear specialization/context of generic RelyingParty.

source_semantics: ARF v3 concept separating relying-party organization from a service/use surface
semantic_note: Potentially valuable mapping but not new Core concept; needs ARF section 3.11.2 extraction.

source_semantics: public national electronic register of registered wallet-relying parties
semantic_note: Government/EUDI specialization of governed TrustRegistry.

source_semantics: designated body establishing/maintaining national RP register and processing registrations
semantic_note: Direct specialization/mapping of existing Registrar role.

source_semantics: certificate authenticating and validating registered wallet-relying party
semantic_note: Certificate is a credential/evidence artifact, not RelyingParty identity itself.

source_semantics: data object describing intended use and attributes RP is registered to request
bounded_context: Trust Governance Context;Authorization Context;Credential Exchange Context
semantic_note: Contains governance/policy/request metadata; no single exact CM4DI equivalent is justified.

source_semantics: registered purpose/use associated with requested data/attributes
semantic_note: Should not create a generic Purpose ontology in CM4DI Core; bridge to policy/privacy vocabularies may be preferable.

source_semantics: harmonized policy informing/limiting requested data to registered intended use
semantic_note: ODRL/DPV neighbor alignment may carry richer policy/purpose semantics.

source_semantics: governed process by which wallet-relying party is registered after verification
semantic_note: Distinct from Identity Enrollment and Provisioning.

eudi_construct: Suspension or Cancellation of RP Registration
source_semantics: governance lifecycle actions changing validity of wallet-relying party registration
semantic_note: Reinforces governed participation status history.

source_semantics: national scheme defining functional, cybersecurity and data-protection certification requirements
semantic_note: Certification scheme is not Certification event and not TrustAssessment.

source_semantics: body responsible for development and maintenance of certification scheme
semantic_note: May be played by CAB/government/trade association etc.; roleMixin interpretation is appropriate.

source_semantics: body evaluating conformity within certification framework
semantic_note: Existing profile concept directly supported.

source_semantics: process/status establishing conformity of wallet solution against required scheme
semantic_note: FCAF functional conformance complements but does not replace security certification.

source_semantics: governed list carrying trusted providers/entities/trust anchors under applicable EU trust model
semantic_note: Distinct from TrustRegistry and TrustAnchor.

source_semantics: ETSI TS 119 602 list mechanism now supported alongside Trusted Lists for trust-anchor retrieval
semantic_note: Keep external list type distinct in mappings; do not collapse all governed lists into one encoding.

source_semantics: verification root/material retrieved by wallets/relying parties/issuers from governed trust sources
semantic_note: Still distinct from list/registry/framework and from SPIFFE TrustDomain.

source_semantics: wallet capability to present selected attributes/data rather than full credential set
semantic_note: Supports existing profile concept; implementation/cryptographic method remains profile-specific.

source_semantics: authentication of wallet user before wallet operations/disclosure
semantic_note: Do not conflate user-to-wallet authentication with credential presentation or relying-party validation.

source_semantics: shared reusable functional test cases for wallet-solution requirements, complementing security certification
semantic_note: Primarily an evaluation/conformance source, not ontology class admission evidence.
